coverage_C.multiplicity: Bonferroni over 3 metrics x all unique direct/forced-decision slots; direct-natural aliases direct-forced only after exact invariance; no independence across metrics assumed
coverage_C.derivation: For X~Binomial(2000,p), lo=min{k:CDF(k)>=eta}, hi=min{k:CDF(k)>=1-eta}. Inclusive lo<=count<=hi; exact integer CDF comparisons. IID outer replicates with fixed independent generator streams assumed; calibration nominal p is a null reference, not a theorem about this method.
coverage_C.null_interval: uncovered in every full-R numerator; report available-interval diagnostic separately
coverage_C.natural_decision_coverage: report full-R and conditional-on-reached separately; no nominal conditional-coverage gate

new_interior_power.derivation: lower exact binomial quantile at (1/20)/metric_tests under p=.80; new rows sized/effected analytically above .80, not assumed at .77

count_policies.legacy_gate_multiplicity: 120 and1540 project gates are preserved as fixed conjunctive obligations; no familywise MC false-failure guarantee is claimed for those legacy gates; no widening from multiplicity
count_policies.denominators: always full requested R, never completed/scorable/reached only
count_policies.stopping: exactly requested R and B, once; no early success/futility stop, retries, extension, rescue, replacement, seed search or outcome-based omissions; process loss leaves failed/incomplete evidence
